content.json:
# ViaSmiles Email Delivery — Deep Insights
Filter by clinic and delivery status below; every chart and the detail grid respond to your selection. Data is live from `law-claraportemail`.

parameters.name: ClinicFilter
parameters.query:
ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(RecipientId)
| extend Clinic = strcat(SenderUsername, "@", SenderDomain)
| distinct Clinic
| order by Clinic asc

parameters.name: StatusFilter
parameters.query:
ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(RecipientId)
| distinct DeliveryStatus
| order by DeliveryStatus asc

parameters.name: EngagementFilter
parameters.query:
ACSEmailUserEngagementOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| distinct EngagementType
| order by EngagementType asc

content.json:
### Delivery Status Breakdown  
*Click a row to filter the page by that status.*

content.query:
let statusRows = ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(RecipientId)
| extend Clinic = strcat(SenderUsername, "@", SenderDomain)
| where ('value::all' in ({ClinicFilter})) or (Clinic in ({ClinicFilter}))
| summarize Count = dcount(InternetMessageId) by DeliveryStatus
| project Label = DeliveryStatus, ClickValue = DeliveryStatus, Count;
let totalRow = ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(RecipientId)
| extend Clinic = strcat(SenderUsername, "@", SenderDomain)
| where ('value::all' in ({ClinicFilter})) or (Clinic in ({ClinicFilter}))
| summarize Count = dcount(InternetMessageId)
| project Label = "Sent (Total) - click to reset", ClickValue = "value::all", Count;
totalRow
| union statusRows
| order by iff(Label == "Sent (Total) - click to reset", 0, 1) asc, Count desc

content.json:
### Engagement Breakdown — Delivered Messages Only  
*Click a row to filter by engagement type. Viewed/Clicked counts are distinct messages that were actually delivered.*

content.query:
ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(RecipientId)
| extend Clinic = strcat(SenderUsername, "@", SenderDomain)
| where ('value::all' in ({ClinicFilter})) or (Clinic in ({ClinicFilter}))
| where ('value::all' in ({StatusFilter})) or (DeliveryStatus in ({StatusFilter}))
| summarize Count = count() by DeliveryStatus
| order by Count desc

ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(RecipientId)
| extend Clinic = strcat(SenderUsername, "@", SenderDomain)
| where ('value::all' in ({ClinicFilter})) or (Clinic in ({ClinicFilter}))
| where ('value::all' in ({StatusFilter})) or (DeliveryStatus in ({StatusFilter}))
| summarize Count = count() by Clinic
| order by Count desc

ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(RecipientId)
| extend Clinic = strcat(SenderUsername, "@", SenderDomain)
| where ('value::all' in ({ClinicFilter})) or (Clinic in ({ClinicFilter}))
| where ('value::all' in ({StatusFilter})) or (DeliveryStatus in ({StatusFilter}))
| summarize Count = count() by Clinic, DeliveryStatus
| order by Clinic asc

ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(RecipientId)
| extend Clinic = strcat(SenderUsername, "@", SenderDomain)

| where ('value::all' in ({StatusFilter})) or (DeliveryStatus in ({StatusFilter}))
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 12h), DeliveryStatus

ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(RecipientId)
| extend Clinic = strcat(SenderUsername, "@", SenderDomain)

| where ('value::all' in ({StatusFilter})) or (DeliveryStatus in ({StatusFilter}))
| project TimeGenerated, RecipientId, Clinic, DeliveryStatus, FailureReason, SmtpStatusCode

content.json: ### Engagement Event Detail — Delivered Messages Only

content.query:
let deliveredIds = ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(RecipientId)
| where DeliveryStatus == "Delivered"
| extend Clinic = strcat(SenderUsername, "@", SenderDomain)
| where ('value::all' in ({ClinicFilter})) or (Clinic in ({ClinicFilter}))
| distinct InternetMessageId;
ACSEmailUserEngagementOperational
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ('value::all' in ({EngagementFilter})) or (EngagementType in ({EngagementFilter}))
| where InternetMessageId in (deliveredIds)
| project TimeGenerated, RecipientId, EngagementType, InternetMessageId, UserAgent
| order by TimeGenerated desc

bladeParameters.name: q
bladeParameters.value:
ACSEmailUserEngagementOperational
| where InternetMessageId == "{InternetMessageId}"
| order by TimeGenerated desc
